notes.title: v1.10 UPDATE - ITALIAN, FRENCH, SPANISH ARE HERE!
notes.notes:
Happy New Year all, wishing you all the best!

And what a way to start it, with 3 new languages! Added Italian, French and Spanish and believe us, that was not an easy task, enjoy!

If you find any translation issue or bug, please let us know :)

Cheers!

notes.title: German 1.08 Update!
notes.notes:
Hey folks! We are back with some great news: the game is now fully translated to German for you to enjoy! We'd appreciate the comments and feedback from our German friends :) Tschüss!

1.08 Changelog:

+ Added full german Translation
+ Previously selected dialogue options are now greyed out

* Small audio fixes during the finale
* Alt+Enter for switching window/fullscreen mode updates settings screen tickboxes properly

notes.title: 'How to play' Update 1.07!
notes.notes:
Time for our first update! So let's see:

+ Addition
* Fix / Change

+ 'How to Play' instructions at Titlescreen
+ Disclaimer when clicking New Game
+ Sfx when solving final weird slots puzzle
+ Sfx for Mason's machete on the door
+ Feedback to player when placing all totem in weird slots puzzle but incorrectly
* Changed the riddle for the cat totem to be more clear
* Spelling Fixes

Enjoy and please keep reporting any issues found! Also don't forget to post your review pls, it will help us greatly!

Many thanks,
Dionous Games
